label: The split-off ending piece where 'e' meets another vowel (-ea, -ée, -ae, -eus, -eo) at the end of a longer proper name: Medea, Nicaea, Hosea, Galatea, Elysée, Renée, Désirée, Mycenae, Philae, Odysseus, Orfeo. Second trigger: the garden word allée(s). Quiet for short names (Thea, Lea, Bea), names ending without that 'e' (Lavinia, Samoa, Joshua, Daphne, Penelope), names that are one whole token (Korea, Athena, Crimea), and ordinary words with the same ending (fiancée, idée, nausea, antennae, algae).

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit
